Class GenericTypeDeserializerGenerator

java.lang.Object
me.bristermitten.mittenlib.annotations.compile.deserializer.GenericTypeDeserializerGenerator
public class GenericTypeDeserializerGenerator extends Object
Generates deserialization code for generic collection types (specifically List and Map) where the element or value types are custom configuration types.

    • handleGenericType

      public Optional<com.palantir.javapoet.MethodSpec> handleGenericType(com.palantir.javapoet.MethodSpec.Builder builder, TypeElement dtoType, Property property, io.toolisticon.aptk.tools.TypeMirrorWrapper wrappedElementType, io.toolisticon.aptk.tools.wrapper.TypeElementWrapper elementType)
      Generates and appends deserialization logic for generic collection properties.

      For a List, generates: 

          return CollectionsUtils.deserializeList(itemsFromMap, context, ctx0 -> ...);
      Parameters:
      builder - the method spec builder
      property - the property being processed, used to generate the variable name (e.g. itemsFromMap)
      wrappedElementType - the wrapped property type mirror
      elementType - the wrapped property type element
      Returns:
      an optional method spec if handled successfully
